text: Underway in match eleven!
Patchford immediately instructs Turingham to apply pressure high and drop into a defensive cover lane.
Patchford breaks clear down the right!
The terminal black shirt surges along the touchline, closing in on the Manus penalty area with real intent.
GOAL! A nightmare start for Manus FC as Prompt turns it into their own net! Yet another own goal this season, and Codex City take the lead: Manus FC nil, Codex City one!
Trace signals to the violet backline to clear their lines without taking any further risks in midfield.
Manus FC applying relentless pressure here, pinning Codex deep in their own territory.
Patchford drives forward through the left channel!
Inches away! Patchford stabs it right from the goal mouth, but it shaves the post and bounces wide! Remarkable let-off for Manus FC.
Trace has broken right through from deep, completely untracked with nothing between them and the net!
GOAL! Trace tucks it away from close range, and Manus FC are level! It is Manus FC one, Codex City one!
Trace alerts Prompt to recalibrate and reset their positioning across the middle third.
Patchford pushes the magenta ball into the attacking third along the right.
Prompt loses footing on the left touchline and tumbles over, but the gyros do their job and they will be upright shortly.
Patchford marches right through the middle, eyeing up another opening inside the box.
Codex City have Manus FC completely boxed in right now, probing patiently around the perimeter.
Agonisingly close for Codex City! A point-blank swipe flashes just wide of the target. Manus survive the onslaught.
GOAL! Prompt bundles it over the line! Manus FC lead two-one!
Trace urgently reminds Prompt to stay vigilant and sweep away any loose balls from the danger zone.
Prompt clatters Turingham to the deck!
Turingham retaliates, down goes Prompt!
Codex teammates collide in a heap!
Total chaos! Now Trace and Prompt crash into each other, leaving Trace sprawled on the turf! Metal on metal everywhere!
GOAL! Amid the utter mayhem, Prompt scrambles the ball home! It is Manus FC three, Codex City one!
Patchford shouts for immediate pressure to cut off the violet counter-attack.
GOAL! Patchford strikes right before the buzzer! A vital lifeline: Manus FC three, Codex City two!
Prompt surges clean through again!
And that brings a breathless first half to a close. Five goals, collisions galore, and Manus FC hold a slender 3-2 lead over Codex City.
Point blank, but somehow pushed just wide!
GOAL! Prompt will not be denied this time, ramming the rebound home! Manus FC extend their advantage: Manus FC four, Codex City two!
Just past the right post!
Patchford drives into the right channel.
Codex City pressing hard inside the box.
The corner ram panel fires the ball back into the mixer!
Prompt picks up the rebound and breaks clean away into open territory!
Prompt marches through the centre circle, turning defense into attack in the blink of an eye.
GOAL! Trace buries it from two metres! Manus FC lead five-two!
Turingham signals that the defensive outlet is established and calls for a reset.
Patchford sends Trace to the deck!
Trace flattens Turingham in response!
Prompt overbalances and topples on the touchline, but self-rights immediately.
Trace knocks Turingham down again!
Prompt stumbles right on the goal line and goes down once more.
Now Trace takes a tumble!
GOAL! It is another own goal, this time off Patchford! Everything that could go wrong is going wrong for Codex City: Manus FC six, Codex City two!
Patchford charges right to the net!
GOAL! Instant redemption for Patchford, firing home from two metres out! That trims the deficit: Manus FC six, Codex City three!
A whisker wide! That could have put the game completely to bed!
GOAL! Prompt smashes it in from point-blank range! Manus FC pull away: Manus FC seven, Codex City three!
Prompt calls for immediate pressure.
Patchford bursts clean through, with time slipping away for Codex!
Patchford weaves into the right channel, searching for a quick route back into this.
Heavy challenge from Patchford! Prompt gets knocked clean off their feet, but with little over two minutes left, Codex are running out of time.
GOAL! Patchford scores! Seven to four!
Codex City keep the hammer down in the final third. Under two minutes remaining, they need three goals to pull off a miracle.
A brief lull as Turingham collects in midfield. Codex have shown plenty of grit, but Manus FC's clinical finishing has proved the difference here as we enter the closing stages.
Into the final minute, and Prompt signals their intention to direct the ball centrally towards the target to kill this match off.
GOAL! Trace delivers the knockout blow from two metres out! That seals the points for the violet shirts: Manus FC eight, Codex City four!
GOAL! Patchford grabs another consolation right on the edge of the goal mouth! Manus FC eight, Codex City five in the dying seconds!
Full time: Manus FC eight, Codex City five. Join us next for AFC Fable against Singularity United.
